title: Audio stream byte shift
summary: Recover cdecl routine at VA 0x58dad0 (RVA 0x18dad0), 66 bytes. Invoke backend read at table +8 through stream +0x6d3c with count 1. Preserve -10; map other non-1 counts to 0; on 1 append an unsigned byte to the accumulator with a wrapping eight-bit left shift. Accumulator is read after the callback. Direct original disassembly and four table entries at +0x10 confirm dispatch registration; individual indirect caller identities remain unresolved. GCC differential tests pass against a byte-verified oracle linked at its original address. Readable source compiled with pinned VS2013 under O1, O2 and O2 /Oy-; no source byte-matching claim.
test_description: 55,296 differential cases: nine statuses (-10, INT_MIN, -11, -1, 0, 1, 2, 255, INT_MAX), every byte 0..255, six accumulator seeds, callback mutation on/off, and accumulator separate or inside stream storage. Also two failed reads without writing the byte destination. Assert callback identity/count/call count, return status, accumulator value, overflow, zero extension, callback side effects, complete stream memory equality, independently expected untouched bytes, backend pointer and output guards. Install test-owned FS backing and check head restoration after every oracle call. Freestanding GCC i386 fixed flags; accepted oracle independently compared against all 66 original bytes and run at 0x58dad0.
known_limits: Only the assigned routine is recovered. Stream prefix and unused backend entries remain opaque; backend I/O and real audio decoding are controlled callbacks, not recovered dependencies.
Requires a valid stream and readable backend table with callable cdecl read slot. Accumulator must be valid when status is 1; no null-pointer checks are invented.

Successful reads must initialize the requested byte. Original scratch aliases the high byte of its incoming stream pointer argument; a success callback that fails to write observes that pointer byte in the original. This malformed backend behavior and callbacks inspecting or retaining the scratch address are outside the portable contract.
No exception, unwind, reentrant callback, concurrent access, or OS audio validation. Individual indirect callers have not been identified beyond original backend dispatch table registration.
32-bit layout and ABI validated; on 64-bit ports backend slot offsets naturally follow native pointer size while stream backend offset remains 0x6d3c. Full original stream layout is not established.
Source is classified high_level_unmatched; compiler success and behavioral tests do not establish matching original code generation.
